newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's securities watchdog reprimands Seapower.
newsitem.headline: HK's securities watchdog reprimands Seapower.

text.p: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) said on Thursday it had reprimanded Seapower Securities Ltd for failing to implement internal controls and procedures to detect possible short selling.

It said it had also reprimanded Seapower for failing to implement effective procedures for monitoring house cross trades, ensure that an adequate audit trail was in place to detect client and staff trading malpractice and ensure it had adequate resources to supervise its employees diligently.
The SFC acknowledged in a statement however that Seapower had introduced a number of initiatives since mid-1996 to improve its compliance system.

The SFC also suspended the registration of Lee Yuen-san as a dealer's representative of Roctec Securities Co Ltd for three months for involvement in trading malpractices that disadvantaged Roctec's clients and for short selling securities.
